title: Science Prediction Universe
abstract: arXiv:2611.15049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Humanity has long sought to explain natural phenomena. Reliable prediction of experimental outcomes is a central test of our understanding of the processes that produce them. If artificial general intelligence (AGI) is to surpass human scientific capabilities, it must also predict experimental outcomes more reliably than humans. Such capabilities could accelerate scientific discovery across disciplines, help address humanity's most pressing challenges, and improve human well-being. We introduce Science Prediction Universe (SPU), a benchmark of hidden experimental outcomes with 100 public verified tasks from chemistry, materials science, biology and medicine, and 16 private tasks from unpublished wet-lab experiments. Given an experimental setup and candidate conditions, an agent works with any resources it needs to rank the candidates by a measured outcome. translated_abstract: 人类长期以来一直致力于解释自然现象。对实验结果的可靠预测是检验我们对产生这些结果的过程理解程度的核心标准。如果通用人工智能（AGI）想要超越人类的科学能力，它也必须比人类更可靠地预测实验结果。这种能力可以加速跨学科的科学发现，帮助应对人类最紧迫的挑战，并改善人类福祉。我们介绍了科学预测宇宙，这是一个包含隐藏实验结果的基准测试，包含来自化学、材料科学、生物学和医学领域的100个公开验证任务，以及来自未发表湿实验室实验的16个私有任务。给定实验设置和候选条件，智能体可以利用其所需的任何资源，根据测量的结果对候选条件进行排序。我们评估了涵盖十二个前沿模型的十三种智能体配置……
tldr: 该论文提出了“科学预测宇宙”基准，包含100个公开验证任务和16个来自未发表湿实验室实验的私有任务，用于评估AI智能体在化学、材料科学、生物学和医学领域预测实验结果的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Science Prediction Universe (SPU), a benchmark of hidden experimental outcomes with 100 public verified tasks and 16 private tasks from unpublished wet-lab experiments, designed to evaluate AI agents' ability to predict experimental results across chemistry, materials science, biology, and medicine.
